verdict.rationale: Workspace documents Apps Script as its own low-code environment for automating Admin console tasks (docs-14, docs-19), and dynamic groups apply membership rules automatically (docs-30). However, nothing in the evidence shows user-defined rules firing actions in response to events. Automatic provisioning sync (docs-13) is a fixed built-in behavior, not a user-defined rule. Missing for 10: documented event-based triggers (e.g., on email arrival, file change, or form submit), a rule-builder or condition-action workflow UI, AI-assisted rule creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
